title: Route Boolean reference-operation counting through the existing shared operand-admission owner

masterplan.active_gate: Gate 1 — Renovation, owner-directed Genesis and general computer assistance

question: Can the diagnostic reference-operation counter stop acting as a weaker parallel admission seam and reuse the same exact Boolean/Fourfold operand contract already shared by the surviving CPU and CUDA arms?

change.single_owner: Keep experiments.tensor_gpu.boolean_probe_contract as the sole semantic-admission owner; exact_reference_operation_count now invokes validate_boolean_operands before counting CSR scalar work.
change.removed_parallel_rule: Delete the counter's local middle-axis-only admission check, which previously allowed cross-subject operands whenever their typed middle axes happened to match.
change.preserved_behavior: For already-admitted operands, operation counting remains the same deterministic sum over right-row spans selected by left CSR column indices.
change.regression: Pin CPU and CUDA imports to the same shared operation-count function and prove a same-shape/different-Fourfold-subject pair refuses before any diagnostic count is returned.

same-shape operands bound to different exact Fourfold subjects refuse in operation counting

finding.summary: After GPU-175 centralized physical-arm operand admission, exact_reference_operation_count still carried a separate weaker rule that checked only middle-axis equality. Reusing the canonical experiment validator removes that residual parallel semantic seam.
finding.expected_effect: Diagnostic work accounting cannot silently accept cross-revision/cross-subject or non-Boolean operands that the actual physical execution arms would refuse.
finding.negative_result: This packet does not establish a GPU backend, Tensor-Core use, performance improvement, production Tensor adoption, or Tensor/Fourfold superiority.
